title: 2023 Panini Select Die-Cut #23 Mohamoud Diabate Cleveland Browns Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2023 Panini Select sports trading card featuring Mohamoud Diabate of the Cleveland Browns in the National Football League (NFL). The card is a Black Red Die Cut parallel variety rookie card made of card stock. It is part of the 2023 Panini Select set and is manufactured in the United States. The card number is 23 and it is an original licensed reprint in English language.
